title: m2w-weights (weights/manifest.json)
description: The weight shards of a package: per-layer files of int4 (nibble-packed, low nibble first) and float16 tensors named exactly like the graph inputs, plus the embedding / lm_head table.

container.description: every shard is a .safetensors file (int4 stored as U8 with the last axis halved); offsets in this manifest are absolute file offsets. Absent in older packages: raw *.bin shards

layout.description: int4 weights are [groups, outputChannels, group_size], scales [groups, outputChannels, 1]

vision.description: Qwen3.5 image tower: the format of the linear weights of the vision_* files (int8: weight [out, in] + scale [out, 1] per row symmetric; int8g128: int8 data [in/128, out, 128] + a scale per block [in/128, out, 1], the int4 layout; int4: group 128 like the text layers; float16: weight only)

grid.description: vision_grid files: the (grid_h, grid_w) preset the tables (pos_embed, rope_cos, rope_sin) belong to

kind.description: layer files of Gemma-style models: the attention kind of the layer

relative_error.description: per projection: squared quantization error / squared norm of the weight (layer files)
